answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The juniper holds work receipts rather than names, so the trellis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, idle agents bleed standing. By the wander of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
